The '''''Raptor''''' was a [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] under the command of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] during his attempted coup d'état.

==History==
It attempted to destroy three [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avenger]] manufacturing plants at Omar. While it succeeded at destroying the plants, the base personnel were given enough time to be successfully evacuated and the frigate was destroyed by [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
